clue.text: Reason to accept line in part of legal document

parts.note: a reason is a cause

clue.text: Most socialists will accept rising prices

will accept means the two words take in the run of letters that spans them

explanation.walkthrough: 'will accept' marks the hidden STSOC across 'Most socialists'; 'rising' reads it backwards, up the column.
explanation.definitionFit: Costs are the prices paid or charged for things.

clue.text: Lobs diapers out right away -if they're this

indicators.note: out means not in proper order, so the letters are rearranged
away signals the named letter is taken out of the word

explanation.definitionFit: Throwaway nappies are designed to be binned after one use rather than washed.

clue.text: What about beginning to investigate street crime?
